text:
ana: Quick follow-up from the PM: need concrete owners and Jira links for the KV-cache postmortem actions. We saw repeat eviction storms during two traffic spikes last week.

raj: I'll take lead on the investigation ticket. Will gather logs and heatmaps.

matt: I'll own the immediate config change + canary. Can someone give me the exact thermostat values we agreed?

ana: (typo) ana: agreed values: eviction_threshold=0.75, target_free_ratio=0.18. Put these in the short-term ticket.

raj: Created RW-3790: "Primary investigation - KV cache eviction storm" assigned to raj, due 2026-04-08. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3790

matt: Created RW-3791: "Short-term eviction tweak + alerting" assigned to matt, due 2026-03-29. Will canary tonight.

jira-bot: RW-3791 created and assigned to matt.

matt: Canary plan: patch config map, restart cache-workers, monitor p95 and eviction-rate for 30m. Command: 
```
kubectl -n inference patch cm cache-config -p '{"data":{"eviction_threshold":"0.75","target_free_ratio":"0.18"}}' && kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/cache-workers
```

oncall-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-24T02:15:00Z and alert window 30m.

kim: I'll take the dashboard/alert ownership. Creating RW-3792 for dashboards and updated alerts, due 2026-03-31.

sophie: I'll own the regression tests and add a probe into Redwood Optimize to detect eviction anomalies. Ticket RW-3793, due 2026-04-20.

ana: Suggested RACI for these: R=Raj (investigations), A=Ana (postmortem author), C=Eng-SRE (matt, kim), I=Product (eva-pm), S=Support (sophie). Confirm?

eva-pm: I will be I for visibility and will evaluate batching changes with product. Please tag me on the cross-team ticket.

raj: Adding acceptance criteria to RW-3790: 1) reproduce eviction signature with trace, 2) identify misbehaving tenant or batch, 3) recommend mitigation.

matt: Adding ACs to RW-3791: 1) canary shows eviction_rate < 3/min at 2x baseline, 2) p95 latency change < 7%, 3) no TS errors during window.

kim: RW-3792 ACs: dashboard has 1m eviction rate metric, tenant heatmap, and an alert when eviction_rate > 5/min for 5m.

matt: Noted pattern: both spikes correlate with the nightly compaction job at ~01:30 UTC. We should open a coordination ticket with Product to shift or stagger jobs.

ana: I'll create RW-3794: "Batch scheduling review to avoid KV contention" and assign to eva-pm, due 2026-04-07.

eva-pm: Acknowledged, will discuss with infra PMs and reply by 2026-03-31.

raj: Scheduling pairing with matt tomorrow 08:00 PST to go through eviction traces and tenant-level metrics.

matt: I'll post canary logs and a short summary back into this thread after the run.

ana: Let's also add a recurring monthly check for cache health to the postmortem board so these patterns don't slip. Sophie can own the quarterly evals.

sophie: happy to do quarterly evals and add automated alerts into Optimize.

matt: FYI I'll attach the canary runbook to RW-3791 after the deploy.

jira-bot: RW-3791 status: In Progress  canary scheduled. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RW-3791

ana: Thanks all. We'll reconvene after the canary and investigation updates.
